column1: # Hand-written exceptions for P1 (SMNP01 rev 1), read by gen_variant.py and verify_variant.py.
# Columns, tab-separated: E1 address (or E1 first-last range)   P1 address | none   reason
# An entry replaces the address map's mapping there, and lets verify_variant.py accept a hook or a
# code address in code that is not identical or equivalent on P1. `none` removes the mapping: a
# runtime use of that address then fails to build (NSMBW_VA), on purpose.

column3: the runtime's initial guest stack pointer (main.cpp SeedCpuContext), not a game address
the end of MEM1, a bound in range checks: the same on every version
